clue.text: Writer sending letters from France?
Woody building encircles center of groves — it's a long story
Part of comforter is entirely out of bed
Confused realist is taking to philosopher
The originator of Mickey (a mouse!) is likely to inherit the earth
Opie paints badly? That's irrelevant
Pass upbeat member of trio
Mother to arrange gray flower
Butcher finally cuts piece of meat for band
What's left of garment inside of tiger
First male insect is unyielding
24 traveling most of the distance
Quick-tempered person fit to be thrown in a steeple
Poet getting up to fish for bathroom tissue
Al and Betsy seen outside club? That's a lot to bear
Italian in British Columbia originally explained the tale of Damon and Pythias, for instance
Bolt after second-rate obstacle
Greasing criminals in Montana?
Termination of outrageous rent for boutique
Resolve to imprison leader of Ukraine for lying
Scopes trial ultimately situated poorly
Doctor removing part of tail from fish
My pal manipulated and put away costar?
Fruit among nuts
Point around back of juke joint
Loud musical instrument?!
Long lens reveals valley
Prisoner turning west and heading to Oregon? That's impossible
Something associated with an island vacation? Yes!
Snarled sternly, "Gee, no — it's people!"
